title: Tighten Client Registry data protection and query responses
requirements:
- Correct 'pseudo-anonymisation' to 'pseudonymisation' and note pseudonymised data remains personal data
- Return only authorised fields rather than full cross-reference maps
- Replace the 'right to be forgotten' with applicable data-subject rights subject to statutory retention
- Define public and restricted search profiles with limits against enumeration
- Govern pseudonym generation to prevent a central linkability service
- Break 'conformance with data-protection legislation' into testable controls
